title: AgRefactor: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflow for HLS Compatibility and Performance
abstract: arXiv:2606.30949v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: High-Level Synthesis (HLS) provides a fast path from concepts to silicon, but converting real-world software into synthesizable HLS code remains challenging due to restrictive language support and the gap between software and hardware programming practices. Existing automated and LLM-based refactoring approaches partially address this problem, yet they often lack flexibility, struggle to scale, and incur high computational costs. We introduce AgRefactor, an LLM-based multi-agent workflow for refactoring software into HLS-compatible programs. AgRefactor incorporates a self-evolving memory system that accumulates and retrieves factual and strategic knowledge across tasks, improving robustness and efficiency on unseen programs. To reduce cost and enhance scalability, it integrates automated refactoring tools, enabling agents to balance LLM-driven rewrites with efficient tool-based transformations. translated_title: AgRefactor：面向HLS兼容性与性能的自进化智能体工作流
translated_abstract: 高层综合（HLS）提供了从概念到硅片的快速路径，但由于受限的语言支持以及软件与硬件编程实践之间的差距，将现实世界的软件转换为可综合的HLS代码仍然具有挑战性。现有的自动化和基于LLM的重构方法部分解决了这一问题，但它们往往缺乏灵活性、难以扩展，且计算成本高昂。我们引入了AgRefactor，一种基于LLM的多智能体工作流，用于将软件重构为HLS兼容程序。AgRefactor集成了一个自进化记忆系统，该系统跨任务积累和检索事实性与策略性知识，从而提高了对未见程序的鲁棒性和效率。为降低成本和增强可扩展性，它集成了自动化重构工具，使智能体能够在LLM驱动的重写与高效的基于工具的转换之间取得平衡。在11个具有挑战性的真实世界基准中的9个上，AgRefactor表现优于现有方法。
tldr: AgRefactor通过引入自进化记忆系统和自动化工具集成，实现了高效、可扩展的HLS兼容性重构，在多个真实基准上显著提升了性能。
en_tdlr: AgRefactor introduces a self-evolving memory system and automated tool integration for efficient, scalable HLS-compatible refactoring, outperforming existing methods on multiple real-world benchmarks.
